instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after end-to-end evidence exists.

features.description: The current WebDeb product baseline is documented with code facts, screenshots, validation output, and risk-ranked findings.
steps: Run pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm content:audit, and pnpm build or document blockers.
Capture or cite desktop and mobile screenshots for home and one public article.
Update source-packet.md, progress-log.md, agent-handoff.md, and continuity-ledger.md with current facts.
features.evidence: docs/webdeb_product_upgrade_2026_06_16/reports/wpu-00-baseline-product-audit-report.md records pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm content:audit, local server startup, screenshots, source-packet writeback, and continuity handoff.
features.notes: Authenticated owner screenshots were not captured; downstream owner phases must capture them or document fallback evidence.

features.description: A new reader can identify the first recommended reading path on home, and article readers can enter the article without auxiliary modules dominating the first viewport.
steps: Open / at 1440x900 and 390x844.
Verify home shows search, current/latest article, dual tracks, and a clear first-read path without misleading loading or empty states.
Open /post/goal-harness-agent-phase-protocol at 1440x900 and 390x844.
Verify article title, core claim or reading brief, compact TOC/series affordance, and reader assistant entry are visible without layout overflow.
features.evidence: reports/wpu-01-reader-ia-and-visual-system-report.md; screenshots wpu-01-home-desktop.png, wpu-01-home-mobile.png, wpu-01-post-desktop.png, wpu-01-post-mobile-after.png, wpu-01-algorithms-desktop.png, wpu-01-algorithms-mobile.png, wpu-01-applications-desktop.png, wpu-01-applications-mobile.png, wpu-01-search-zero-mobile.png; validation pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, AUDIT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm audit:ui.
features.notes: Home now has a visible first-read path after search. Mobile article entry and TOC are restored through a final CSS override instead of being hidden. WPU-02 may rely on the article companion entry remaining visible.

features.description: The public Blog Agent answers only from public sources, never exposes raw reasoning, supports useful article/track modes, and renders source-card evidence.
steps: Ask an article-grounded question on a public article.
Verify source cards are shown and no raw reasoning or internal planning is visible.
Ask about hidden/admin/draft content and verify the answer refuses or explains public-source limits.
Verify timeout, cancel, quota, history, and mobile panel states remain usable.
Run focused Agent tests.
features.evidence: reports/wpu-02-article-companion-and-agent-ux-report.md; focused Agent tests passed; pnpm check passed; pnpm build passed; static privacy search found only internal/no-op/test reasoning hits; screenshots wpu-02-agent-desktop.png, wpu-02-agent-mobile.png, wpu-02-agent-hidden-mobile.png, wpu-02-agent-hidden-desktop-final.png.
features.notes: Public stream no longer emits reasoning_delta or final reasoningMarkdown. Client ChatMessage no longer carries reasoningMarkdown, and persisted legacy reasoningMarkdown is ignored. answerMode is sent from the public Agent path via intent inference. Hidden-content prompt was bounded to public-source limits without source cards or hidden text.

features.description: The author can convert reader feedback, search misses, and Agent question radar into a durable writing backlog with clear statuses and privacy boundaries.
steps: Open /manage and /manage/agent as an authenticated owner or document unauthenticated fallback.
Verify feedback, subscriptions, search misses, Agent runs, and question radar are visible as writing signals.
Verify writing backlog statuses persist beyond localStorage if persistence is implemented, or a blocker is documented.
Verify no private context, email, IP, or hidden content is exposed in backlog evidence.
features.evidence: reports/wpu-03-writing-workbench-and-content-backlog-report.md; owner workflow tests passed; pnpm check passed; pnpm test passed; pnpm build passed; screenshots wpu-03-manage-desktop.png, wpu-03-manage-mobile.png, wpu-03-manage-agent-desktop.png, wpu-03-manage-agent-mobile.png, wpu-03-write-seed-desktop.png, wpu-03-write-seed-mobile.png.
features.notes: The owner writing backlog is exposed on /manage and combines feedback, search misses, and Agent question radar ideas. Feedback status is database-backed; Agent idea status persistence remains a documented localStorage gap because no migration was introduced. Contact data is redacted in feedback/search-miss backlog evidence. Browser checks used unauthenticated fallback plus code-level admin evidence.

features.description: Seed, fallback, series catalog, track pages, search, RSS, sitemap, and Agent chunks agree on the same public content atlas.
steps: Verify public and hidden slugs are consistent across seed-blog.mjs, server/publicSeedPosts.ts, shared/content-series.ts, discovery, RSS, sitemap, and Agent chunks.
Verify public fallback articles have series, track, excerpt, cover/thumbnail strategy, and title parity.
Verify search handles key aliases and Chinese/English mixed terms better than plain substring matching, or records a blocker.
Run content, discovery, SEO, and publish-freshness tests.
features.evidence: reports/wpu-04-content-atlas-and-article-quality-report.md; focused content/discovery/SEO/freshness tests passed; pnpm content:audit passed; pnpm content:verify passed with 7 public posts, 114 chunks, 0 blockers; pnpm check passed; pnpm test passed; browser route evidence wpu-04-*.png and wpu-04-*.txt.
features.notes: Fallback public posts now derive primary series metadata from shared/content-series.ts. Discovery search supports lightweight aliases for mixed Chinese/English topic queries while keeping hidden/draft posts excluded. RSS includes lastBuildDate and atom:updated. Search miss persistence remains deferred and documented; WPU-03 redaction remains in place.

features.description: A release candidate can prove UI, Agent, content freshness, feeds, sitemap, hidden-content boundaries, privacy, and rollback readiness in one evidence packet.
steps: Run pnpm check, pnpm test, pnpm build, pnpm content:audit, pnpm content:publish, and focused Agent tests or document blockers.
Run browser route checks against a live local server.
Verify release report marks skipped checks as blocked or waived, never silently passing.
Verify rollback notes and non-deployment status are explicit unless the user approved deployment.
features.evidence: reports/wpu-05-release-and-evaluation-gates-report.md; pnpm check passed; pnpm test passed with 32 files and 201 tests; pnpm content:audit passed; pnpm content:publish passed with 7/7 public posts indexed, 114 chunks, 1 hidden/draft excluded, 0 blockers; pnpm build passed; AUDIT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm audit:baseline:quick passed; AUDIT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 pnpm audit:ui passed; browser evidence wpu-05-*.png, wpu-05-*.txt, wpu-05-agent-hidden-refusal.json.
features.notes: Release verdict is locally passing and deployment was approved in the 2026-06-17 review turn. Baseline quick retains 4 known gaps but exits successfully with 14 route checks and 0 skipped routes. Owner authenticated screenshots were not available; Manage Agent fallback plus admin-only tests/code evidence are recorded. Generated evidence files should be curated before commit.
